newsitem.title: USA: Deeptech says group exercises warrants.
newsitem.headline: Deeptech says group exercises warrants.

text.p: DeepTech International Inc said on Thursday that Westgate International LP exercised 472,973 warrants to buy an equivalent number of commmon shares at $5 a share.
Highwood Partners LP acquired the warrants in December 1995 in a rig financing arrangement, DeepTech said. The warrants were assigned to Westgate, the company said.
A DeepTech spokeswoman said Westgate, which now owns 2.7 percent of DeepTech's common stock, and Highwood are controlled by the same party, but she was unable to say who controls the partnerships.
